prompt:

specific requirement from the tender's requirements document.

The contractor must submit a Project Management Plan (PMP) with their proposal demonstrating understanding of the scope, schedule, and service level requirements, including at minimum a communications and task matrix, an identified individual responsible for deliverables, a preliminary delivery/install/user acceptance schedule, a time estimate per critical task, an outline of progress-tracking processes, and an approach to identifying and resolving potential project problems.

[1] Price Schedule:
Attached is our fully priced Schedule of Items (Attachment C), covering
all 1,331 line items across all five ordering periods. Northern Plains
Medical Gases agrees to hold the prices in this offer firm for 90
calendar days from the date specified for receipt of offers.

Project Management Plan:
Our Project Management Plan assigns a single point of contact, Dana
Whitfield, who will coordinate onboarding, task order communications, and
identify and delineate the roles and responsibilities of our dispatch and
billing staff. Dana Whitfield is also responsible for ensuring contract
deliverables are provided on time. A preliminary delivery, install, and
user acceptance schedule is included as Appendix 1, showing task
dependencies and an estimate of how much time each critical task is
expected to take through the first 60 days of performance.

Cylinder Tracking:
For cylinders in transit to and from ordering activities, we will use a
barcode-based tracking system (method: handheld barcode scanners at
pickup and delivery, data stored in a cloud portal) that allows ordering
activity POCs on-demand access to view and extract delivery and location
data for all cylinders moving in and out of their facility.

We do not currently operate a system for tracking medical gas cylinders
within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, and are therefore
not submitting a facility-side tracking plan with this proposal.

[3] Cylinder Management: As described above under Cylinder Tracking, our
barcode-based tracking system represents an innovative use of cylinder
tracking and management technology across the ordering activity network.

Regulatory Compliance: All medical gases supplied under this contract
will conform to the specifications of the United States Pharmacopoeia and
National Formulary, and our gas manufacturing and filling partners are
registered with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

Past Performance:
Contract/Project: VISN 23 Medical Gas Supply IDIQ, Fargo VA Medical
Center. Period of Performance: 2021-2024. Description: cylinder gas
delivery and rental services for a multi-building VA medical campus.
Agency/Facility: Department of Veterans Affairs, Fargo VA Medical Center.
Point of Contact: Marcus Ellingson, Contracting Officer Representative,
(701) 555-0122, marcus.ellingson@va.gov.

Transition / Phase-In Strategy:
Our phase-in strategy includes a Project Communications Plan identifying
Dana Whitfield as the point of contact for all phase-in and ongoing
contract communications, along with the roles of our dispatch and billing
staff who will support this contract through the period of performance.
We will also submit an Implementation Plan describing depot staffing and
cylinder-inventory buildup during the phase-in period.

[2] We do not currently operate a system for tracking medical gas cylinders
within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, and are therefore
not submitting a facility-side tracking plan with this proposal.

Reporting Capabilities:
Northern Plains Medical Gases will provide on-demand usage, cost, and
cylinder-tracking reports through the same cloud portal referenced above,
covering actual and average deliveries by week, month, and year and by
gas type; actual and average billing data by week, month, and year per
medical gas; and perpetual delivery, pick-up, and location data per
cylinder. Reports will be viewable through the web portal or exported to
an Excel spreadsheet upon request.

Technical Capability:

Operational Capability: Northern Plains Medical Gases has operated a
medical-gas cylinder delivery and rental fleet serving VA and civilian
hospital systems across North Dakota, Minnesota, and Iowa for eleven
years and is fully capable of meeting the requirements of the Statement
of Work described in this solicitation.

Continuity of Operations: In the event of a supply-chain interruption, we
maintain backup supply agreements with two independent industrial gas
fillers and can reroute deliveries from our Sioux Falls depot within 24
hours of a disruption at any other location.

Northern Plains Medical Gases will perform 100% of the work identified in
the Statement of Work and Contract Administration with its own personnel
and equipment; no subcontractors, similarly situated entities, or other
performing parties are proposed. As we are not proposing to use any
subcontractors and are not a large business electing SDVOSB/VOSB
subcontractor credit, we have not included a VAAR 852.219-76 Certificate
of Compliance with this submission.

No amendments to this solicitation had been issued as of the date of this
quote.

Schedule of Items remains pending confirmation from our upstream supplier
and will be provided by change order shortly after award.
